# Construction MCP connectors

2 construction connectors for AnythingMCP. Each one gives Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Cursor and Gemini the MCP tools of one system, on [AnythingMCP Cloud](https://cloud.anythingmcp.com) or on your own server ([run it yourself](../../README.md#run-it-yourself)).

The links open the setup guide for each connector and assistant on anythingmcp.com, in seven languages. All construction connectors: [anythingmcp.com/marketplace/category/construction](https://anythingmcp.com/marketplace/category/construction).

| Connector | What it does | Tools | Setup guides |
|---|---|---|---|
| [PlanRadar](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/planradar-to-mcp) | Manage construction and real estate projects with PlanRadar. | 10 | [Claude](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-planradar-to-claude) · [ChatGPT](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-planradar-to-chatgpt) · [Copilot](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-planradar-to-copilot) · [Cursor](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-planradar-to-cursor) · [Gemini CLI](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-planradar-to-gemini) · [Meta Muse](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-planradar-to-muse) |
| [Procore](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/procore-to-mcp) | Read Procore construction projects: companies, projects and directory, RFIs and submittals, daily and manpower logs, project documents and files, budget views and line items, subcontracts and purchase orders. | 19 | [Claude](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-procore-to-claude) · [ChatGPT](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-procore-to-chatgpt) · [Copilot](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-procore-to-copilot) · [Cursor](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-procore-to-cursor) · [Gemini CLI](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-procore-to-gemini) · [Meta Muse](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-procore-to-muse) |
